hooks.text: 用手指直接绘制元素法术，重叠配方会涌现意外连锁
hooks.excerpt: Every spell is built from elemental patterns cast directly with your fingers. Recipes can overlap and combine , sparking strategies that reward clever play and experimentation.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 八名以上角色分别扭转同一套法术施放规则
hooks.excerpt: 8+ playable characters, each bending the spellcasting system in unique ways
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 越狱不是为了救世，而是赶去参加侄女的生日派对
hooks.excerpt: You’re a wizard. A not-so-heroic wizard imprisoned for wizard crime, awoken from your wizard slumber by an invitation from your niece. Escape from jail and traverse a hostile world crawling with danger.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 细致血腥的画面展现出明确创意愿景。

excerpts.excerpt: Its art is gory and detailed, and there is a beautiful heart of a creative vision here.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 诅咒伤害被认为调得过高。

excerpts.excerpt: the curse damage (which is way overtuned IMO)
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 选择之间缺少形成实质差异的空间。

excerpts.excerpt: There's not enough opportunities to create meaningful differences in the choices you make.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 通关一个法师后，后续角色可以复用同一策略，导致严重重复。

excerpts.excerpt: After playing through with the first mage and winning, you can effectively mirror the strategy with subsequent mages.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 手指经济与符印机制没有得到有意义的深入发展。

excerpts.excerpt: The core mechanisms of the game (finger economy + sigils matter) is not meaningfully built upon by the game
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 角色构筑普遍依赖相同道具。

excerpts.excerpt: all the wizards pretty much needed the same items
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 当前状态下游玩不够有趣。

excerpts.excerpt: it's not really fun to play at the current state
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 卡牌战斗的触感与怪异感独树一帜。

excerpts.excerpt: Pluto's particular flavour of card-based combat feels tactile and off-kilter in an unparalleled way.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段
